subject: reasoning
question:
F, G, H, K, L, and M live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2, and so on till the topmost floor, which is numbered 6. K lives on the topmost floor. Only three people live between K and G. F lives on a floor below G. L lives on an even numbered floor. H lives on an odd numbered floor but not on floor number 5.

How many people live between M and G?
solution:
